item.title: ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ star dies at 53
item.description: Actor and star of the hit television series "Grey's Anatomy," Eric Dane, died on Thursday. He was 53. Dane, who was best known for his role as Dr. Mark Sloan, died just 10 months after he publicly revealed he was battling ALS. He is survived by his ex-wife, actress Rebecca Gayheart, and two children.
